name: Post-Matric Tuition Fee and Examination Fee (Freeship)
description: 1) Create interest in education among students. 2) Making financial assistance available for higher education. 3) To reduce the drop in education leakage. 4) Creating opportunities for financial growth through higher education. 5) Scholarship scheme to avoid transparency, unity and delay. 6) All types of compulsory fees such as Tuition fees, Exam Fees and other admissible fees are reimbursed to the concern SC category student.

evidence.quote: • The parents / Guardian annual income above Rs. 250000.to unlimited.

• Student should be resident of Maharashtra
